test_cases.title: Log in with valid email and password
steps: Enter a valid email and password
test_cases.expected: The My orders page is shown

test_cases.title: Reject empty email and password
test_cases.expected: Both fields show a required-field error

test_cases.title: Accept a password of exactly 8 characters
Reject a password of 65 characters
test_cases.expected: A password length error is shown

test_cases.title: Lock the account after 5 wrong passwords
steps: Enter the email with a wrong password 5 times
test_cases.expected: Login is refused and the account stays locked for 15 minutes

test_cases.title: Use the same error for unknown email and wrong password
steps: Log in with an unknown email
Log in with a known email and wrong password
test_cases.expected: Both attempts show the same generic error
